title: The Idolm@ster: 765 Pro to Iu Monogatari
justification: AniList 11889 (SPECIAL, 1 episode from 2012-06-17) is AniDB 8218's special S1 765 Pro to Iu Monogatari (A Story Called 765Pro), aired 2012-06-17. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 10278, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 8218, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji and native titles. The parent's row places S1 on TVDB 0x2 A Story Called 765Pro (2012-06-17) and, with the TMDB row, on TMDB 63463 S0E2 A Story Called 765Pro (2012-06-17).
